name: MCPVerse
description: MCPVerse is an expansive, real-world benchmark for evaluating agentic tool use by large language models. It integrates over 550 real-world executable tools with a large action space and employs outcome-based evaluation with real-time ground truth for time-sensitive tasks.
reputation: A very recent agentic tool-use benchmark with a large real-world tool set; adoption is still emerging rather than established.
notes: Features a large action space exceeding 140k tokens; evaluates agentic models in real-world scenarios.
